description: Get a protein's amino-acid sequence as plain text and FASTA, ready to paste into BLAST or an alignment tool, with length, organism, gene and evidence level. Give a UniProt accession (P04637) or an isoform (P04637-2). Source: UniProtKB, UniProt Consortium. Returns the canonical sequence UniProt displays; it does not translate DNA, list variants or return gene or mRNA sequences. (cost: 1 credit)

accession.description: string, required, UniProt accession such as P04637, or isoform such as P04637-2 (use protein_for_gene to turn a gene symbol into an accession)

name: protein_sequence
